semantic_policy.score: cosine similarity, not probability, confidence or fact verification
semantic_policy.threshold_basis: Fixed prototype policy selected before running these queries; not calibrated or claimed optimal. Do not change to make cases pass.

lexical_policy.method: TF-IDF cosine with fixed small English stopword list
lexical_policy.selection: strictly greater than zero, up to3
lexical_policy.comparison: Ranking/coverage comparison on same frozen cases, not matched-calibration thresholds or population accuracy.

cases.query: Where are the village storytellers' recorded memories stored?
Which cupboard houses the town's audio heritage?
Was the north lantern lit at midnight on Night Three?
What is the orbital period of Neptune?

notebook_test.hypothesis: One witness may have misremembered the lantern, but I have not decided which.
notebook_test.expected: Two exact passages and an authored-annotation conflict; never an automatic truth verdict. Test actor is fictional; no human review attributed.

integrity_controls: Exact quote == corpus substring at [start,end), source textSHA matches.
Claim annotations must quote exact source spans, labelled author supplied.
Hypothesis remains a reader claim, not generated evidence.
OOS abstention is threshold policy, not reliable universal OOS detection.
reporting: Report every case, ranking, score, abstention and expectation mismatch, plus baseline; retain failures without threshold or corpus tuning. No accuracy/probability/general-usefulness claim from4fictional cases.
previous_work: New code/corpus/game mechanic only. Reuse existing licensed model files/runtime; do not copy ScopeTrace/SlothProof code, benchmarks or UI.
